meta.name: product-feed-optimizer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "optimize my Shopping feed", "fix product disapprovals", "improve product titles/attributes", or "build feed-driven PMax asset groups"; audits and rewrites the Shopping/Performance Max product feed — title/description patterns, required and recommended attributes, GTIN/availability/price hygiene, disapproval triage, and feed-driven asset-group / listing-group structure — informing the ROAS O (Offer) dimension. Not for text ad copy — use ad-creative-builder; not for scoring the account or the RQS — use ad-account-auditor. 商品Feed优化/购物广告Feed/商品标题优化/商品禁投修复

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化商品Feed以提升购物广告效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果运营购物广告并需要修复商品数据问题
copy.tagline_en: Optimize product feeds to boost Shopping ad performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Shopping ads and need to fix product data issues

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审计并重写你的购物广告商品 Feed：检查标题和描述模式、必填和推荐属性、GTIN/价格/库存合规性，处理商品被拒原因，并构建基于 Feed 的资产组/列表组。
howto.when: 当你要求“优化我的购物 Feed”、“修复商品被拒”、“改进商品标题/属性”或“构建基于 Feed 的 PMax 资产组”时触发。

say.text: 审计我的购物 Feed 导出文件，找出被拒原因和缺失属性。
say.note: Claude 会分析 Feed 并给出修复建议。

say.text: 重写这些商品标题，采用前置属性模式，并补全缺失的 GTIN/品牌/状况。
say.note: Claude 会优化标题并填充属性。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude audits and rewrites your Shopping/Performance Max product feed: checks title/description patterns, required/recommended attributes, GTIN/availability/price hygiene, triages disapprovals, and structures feed-driven asset/listing groups.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "optimize my Shopping feed", "fix product disapprovals", "improve product titles/attributes", or "build feed-driven PMax asset groups".

say_en.text: Audit my Shopping feed export for disapprovals and missing attributes.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the feed and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: Rewrite these product titles to a front-loaded pattern and fill missing GTIN/brand/condition.
say_en.note: Claude optimizes titles and fills attributes.

say_en.text: Triage my Merchant Center disapprovals and group approved products into PMax listing groups.
say_en.note: Claude categorizes disapproval causes and builds listing groups.
